personality_one_liner: A calming, ultra-accessible health companion for patients, paired with a clean, high-density operational surface for staff.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for patients (xl/2xl margins). Tighter, structured spacing (md/lg) for the staff dashboard grid.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar
Use on sticky patient confirmation buttons at the bottom of the screen
Use on sticky table headers in the staff dashboard
dont's: Do not use on general list rows
Do not use on data dense areas in the staff view to preserve clarity

screens.name: Patient - Hari Ini (Today)
screens.purpose: A hyper-simplified daily check-in screen for low-literacy patients.

states.error: Failed to load schedule. 'Muat Ulang' (Retry) button.

screens.layout: Vertical stack layout. Top: Warm greeting ('Halo, Budi') and prominent 'Hari ke-18' indicator. Middle: Simple visual progress bar (stepped or circular) indicating treatment phase. Bottom 1/3 (Sticky): Massive full-width primary CTA 'SUDAH MINUM' (brandPrimary). Below it: secondary textual/ghost buttons for 'BELUM BISA MINUM' and 'ADA KELUHAN'. All touch targets min 64pt.

screens.name: Patient - Jadwal (Schedule)
screens.purpose: View upcoming and past medication logs.
screens.layout: Simple list view using cards. Each card represents a day. Green checkmark icon for completed, outlined grey circle for upcoming. Minimal text.

screens.name: Patient - Bantuan (Help)
screens.purpose: Direct access to clinic staff or emergency contact.
screens.layout: Two massive cards filling the screen. Card 1: 'Chat Petugas' (Chat Staff) with WhatsApp icon. Card 2: 'Telepon Darurat' (Emergency Call). Extreme simplicity.

screens.name: Patient - Lapor Keluhan (Report Symptom Flow)
screens.purpose: 2-step modal flow to report why meds weren't taken or side effects.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet or full-screen modal. Step 1: Grid of large 'reason' chips (Mual, Lupa, Habis). Step 2: Severity selection (Ringan, Sedang, Berat). ONLY use RED (error token) if 'Berat' (Severe/Urgent) is selected. Otherwise use warning or brand tones.

screens.name: Staff - Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-density monitoring interface for healthcare workers.
screens.layout: Responsive grid. Mobile: Vertical scrolling. Tablet/Desktop: 2 or 3 column grid. Top row: Key metric cards (Total Patients, Confirmed Today, Alerts). Below: Filterable list/table of priority patients. Use segmented controls for filters (Kelurahan, Phase). Sticky headers for lists.

screens.name: Staff - Patient Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a single patient's adherence and treatment plan.
screens.layout: Multi-section scroll. Top: Patient profile block. Middle: Adherence Calendar (color-coded grid: green=taken, yellow=late, red=missed/alert). Bottom: Alerts management and Treatment Plan editing actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The Patient experience must use an oversized typography scale (start body at 16pt, titles at 24pt/32pt) and massive touch targets (minimum 64pt) to accommodate low digital literacy.

CRITICAL: Adhere strictly to the color rule: Red (`error` token) is ONLY to be used for urgent medical conditions or severe side effects. Standard UI validation errors should use `warning` or subtle `muted` tones to avoid inducing panic.

Implement two distinct layout strategies: the Patient app is a simplified vertical stack with sticky bottom CTAs; the Staff dashboard must utilize a responsive grid (`flexWrap` or `useWindowDimensions`) to adapt to tablet/desktop widths.
Do not use explicit disease imagery or language that creates stigma. Keep the tone warm, encouraging, and centered around the 'Jasmine Green' aesthetic.
Ensure the bottom navigation is only visible on the top-level screens. Modal flows (like symptom reporting) should hide the bottom tab bar.
Typography must be Plus Jakarta Sans across the board. Ensure font weights do not exceed 500 for a clean, non-aggressive feel.
